body: Blocked by 633: the field engine is ~300× slower than the column engine on a large-box drill program in release (measured in PR #625's review). Retirement waits for a fix and a wall-time budget test.
Speed blocker addressed by PR #636 (#633): a field block now builds in µs (was up to a minute); stock_field_cost total 83.9 s → 7.6 s, verdicts unchanged.

Carried from the high-tier review of PR #783 (#587): `Stock::cut_chord` behaves differently on its two engines. The column arm delegates to `Dexel`, which clears everything above the chord's lowest Z. The field arm sweeps the tool along the chord. They can disagree on a tilted chord. **Before this step switches motion's backend to the field engine, add a field-arm agreement test for `cut_chord` on tilted chords**, and decide which behaviour is the law. ## Research findings on #589

### 1. Answers to open questions

**Q1. Can #589 retire the column engine in one commit now?**
No. Prerequisites #586 and #637 are still open, while #584, #585, #587, #588, and #633 are closed. Four production features and two app layers on `upstream/main` still require `Dexel` or `Backend::Column`:
- `crates/motion/src/machining3d/feed.rs` and `crates/motion/src/quality/mod.rs` build `Backend::Column` stocks and call `Stock::set_tops`. `Stock::Field` refuses `set_tops` with `SET_TOPS_FIELD_REFUSAL` in `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/backend_edit.rs`.
- `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/dexel_box.rs` (`simulate_box`) and `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/dexel_outline.rs` (`simulate_outline`) burn sinker EDM electrodes only on `Dexel`. `crates/app/src/stock_sim_held.rs` and `crates/app/src/stock_view.rs` refuse the field arm with `ELECTRODE_FIELD_REFUSAL`.
- `crates/app/src/stock_sim_held.rs` refuses `StockShape::Cylinder` with `FIELD_CARRY_SHAPE_REFUSAL`. The 32-segment cylinder mesh holds less material than the column disc at the rim.
- `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/carry_side.rs` refuses `CarryTurn::Side` on `CarriedStock::Field` with `FIELD_SIDE_CARRY_REFUSAL`. Exact side-on carry in `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/carry_exact.rs` and `carry_history.rs` reads `Dexel::history`.
- `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/mark.rs` (`credit_marks`) calls `cut::simulate` on a `Dexel`.
- `crates/app/src/rest.rs`, `crates/app/src/rest/across.rs`, `crates/app/src/fixture_carried.rs`, and six files in `crates/app/src/operation/` still hold `Dexel` or `Body`.
- Also, 47 test files across `crates/sim`, `crates/app`, and `crates/motion` reference `Backend::Column`, `Stock::Column`, or `Dexel` (not 12 files).

**Q2. Which behaviour is the law for `Stock::cut_chord` on tilted chords?**
The column engine's per-column reach minimum is the law. In `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/dexel.rs`, `Dexel::cut_chord` finds the parameter interval `[t0, t1]` where the disc of radius `r` touches column center `q` (`reach`). It lowers that column to `min(z(t0), z(t1))`, and includes the rim (`rho <= r`). `crates/motion/src/machining3d/shell.rs` depends on this per-column minimum. In `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/backend_edit.rs`, `Stock::Field::cut_chord` calls `SdfField::subtract` with `SdfTool::Flat` and `spanning_flank`. In `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/field_solid.rs` (`upright_flat_foot`) and `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/field_ray.rs` (`seg_rho`), closed-form evaluation covers only level moves and vertical plunges. Oblique chords fall back to 32-round golden section in `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/field_sweep.rs` and skip `flat_tie`. Also, `crates/sim/tests/stock_backend_parity.rs` lacks a tilted-chord test for `Stock::cut_chord`. The field arm must keep `min(z(t0), z(t1))` with inclusive rim ties (`rho <= r`). Parity tests must pin tilted chords before `crates/motion/src/quality/mod.rs` leaves `Backend::Column`.

**Q3. How should a cut-through column report gouge depth when the default flips?**
In `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/carried_read.rs`, `FieldBody::body` sets `top` to the stock floor and `floor` to the stock top on a cut-through column. That keeps `Body::empty_at` true and convicts any part there as a gouge. However, it bounds the reported gouge depth to the stock thickness instead of the tool's depth below the floor. Accept this stock-thickness depth, because the verdict still convicts any part inside the stock. Check `crates/app/tests/carried_engine_agreement.rs` and carried suites for exact below-floor depth checks before flipping `CAMCRAFT_CARRY_ENGINE` (`crates/app/src/stock_sim_held.rs`).

**Q4. Can `Body` and column grids leave together with `dexel*.rs`?**
No, not directly. `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/carry.rs` (`Body`), `carried_read.rs`, `carry_verdict.rs`, `deviate.rs`, `edge_break.rs`, `kernel.rs`, `columns.rs`, `tiles.rs`, and `crates/app/src/fixture_carried.rs` use `Dexel` as a passive height container. Only `dexel.rs` (`cut_*`), `dexel_arc.rs`, `dexel_ball.rs`, `dexel_bull.rs`, `dexel_box.rs`, `dexel_outline.rs`, `cut.rs`, and `mark.rs` run the column cut engine. Split out a passive height-grid type before you delete the cut kernels, or move `Body` and `credit_*` onto `SdfField` and `Columns`.

**Q5. Where is the open-questions note mentioned in #589?**
It was the `Simulation stock representation` entry in `ROADMAP.md` (`git show v0.14.0:ROADMAP.md`). `ROADMAP.md` was retired on 2026-11-08 (`AGENTS.md`), and no open-questions note remains on `upstream/main`. That cleanup step is already complete.

---

### 2. Design proposal (smallest useful first slice first)

Retire the column engine in five small stages. Keep behaviour unchanged until the default flips, then land one final deletion commit:

1. **Smallest useful first slice: align tilted `cut_chord` and move `crates/motion` off `Backend::Column`.**
   Add exact reach and rim-tie evaluation for oblique `SdfTool::Flat` chords in `crates/sim`, and pin tilted chords in `crates/sim/tests/stock_backend_parity.rs`. Then replace `Stock::set_tops` in `crates/motion/src/machining3d/feed.rs` and `crates/motion/src/quality/mod.rs` with field solids, and switch both modules to `Backend::Field`.
2. **Move `credit_marks` and `crates/app` priors off `Dexel` simulation.**
   Evaluate `credit_marks` (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/mark.rs`) on `SdfField` instead of `cut::simulate`. Finish `#586` by replacing `Dexel` in `crates/app/src/operation/` and `crates/app/src/rest.rs` with `Columns` or `Stock`.
3. **Close the three field-engine feature gaps.**
   Implement box and outline sinker EDM sweeps (`SdfTool`), add an analytic cylinder primitive for carried cylinder stock (`FieldBody`), and implement field-based side-on quarter turns (`CarryTurn::Side`, `#874` and `#1805`). Those implementations follow the published `Hart 1996` (CSG min/max) and `Benouamer and Michelucci 1997` (tri-axis ray intervals) specs already cited in `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/`.
4. **Flip the shipped default to `Backend::Field`.**
   Switch `crates/app/src/stock_sim_held.rs` and `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs` to build `Field` directly without `Dexel`, confirm cut-through depth checks pass, and remove `CAMCRAFT_CARRY_ENGINE`.
5. **Final retirement commit.**
   Decouple `Body`, `deviate`, `edge_break`, and `fixture_carried` from `Dexel`. Delete `dexel*.rs`, `cut.rs`, `Backend::Column`, `Stock::Column`, and the comparison suites (`stock_backend_parity`, `stock_engine_agreement`, `carried_engine_agreement`, `carry_engine_agreement`). Port the remaining baseline tests across the 47 test files.

---

### 3. Proposed concrete sub-issues

1. **Title:** `sim(stock): align Stock::cut_chord on tilted chords and pin parity`
   - **What it does:** Make `Stock::Field::cut_chord` match `Dexel::cut_chord` on oblique chords with per-column reach `min(z(t0), z(t1))` and inclusive rim `rho <= r`.
   - **Done means:** `crates/sim/tests/stock_backend_parity.rs` passes tilted-chord tests (upward, downward, and rim-tie chords) on both engines within `FIELD_VERDICT_EPS`.
   - **Priority:** `P6` · **Effort:** `effort:high` · **Area:** `area:sim`

2. **Title:** `motion: switch machining3d::feed and quality from Backend::Column to Backend::Field`
   - **What it does:** Replace `Stock::set_tops` in `crates/motion/src/machining3d/feed.rs` and `crates/motion/src/quality/mod.rs` with field solids, and switch both modules to `Backend::Field`.
   - **Done means:** `crates/motion/src/` contains no `Backend::Column`, and `machining3d` and `quality` goldens stay byte-identical.
   - **Priority:** `P6` · **Effort:** `effort:high` · **Area:** `area:sim`

3. **Title:** `sim(mark): run credit_marks on SdfField and move app operation priors to Columns`
   - **What it does:** Move `credit_marks` in `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/mark.rs` off `cut::simulate`, and finish `#586` by replacing `Dexel` in `crates/app/src/operation/` and `crates/app/src/rest.rs` with `Columns` or `Stock`.
   - **Done means:** `mark.rs` calls no `Dexel` cut code, `crates/app/src/operation/` uses no `Dexel` outside tests, and `mark_credit`, `drill_prior`, and `thread_entry` tests pass.
   - **Priority:** `P6` · **Effort:** `effort:high` · **Area:** `area:sim`

4. **Title:** `sim(edm): add box and outline sinker electrode sweeps to SdfField`
   - **What it does:** Implement rectangular and polygonal extruded electrode sweeps on `SdfField` so `Held::simulate_box`, `Held::simulate_outline`, and `stock_view` run on the field engine.
   - **Done means:** `sinker_burn`, `sinker_orbit`, and `sinker_side` suites agree between engines within `FIELD_VERDICT_EPS`, and `ELECTRODE_FIELD_REFUSAL` is removed.
   - **Priority:** `P6` · **Effort:** `effort:high` · **Area:** `area:sim`

5. **Title:** `sim(carry): support cylinder stock on FieldBody with an analytic cylinder primitive`
   - **What it does:** Build carried cylinder stock on `FieldBody` using an analytic cylinder SDF that matches the column disc rim law.
   - **Done means:** `FieldBody` carries `StockShape::Cylinder`, `carried_engine_agreement` passes a cylinder fixture with zero findings, and `FIELD_CARRY_SHAPE_REFUSAL` is removed.
   - **Priority:** `P6` · **Effort:** `effort:high` · **Area:** `area:sim`

6. **Title:** `sim(carry): support side-on quarter turns on FieldBody without Dexel::history`
   - **What it does:** Implement `CarryTurn::Side` (`#874` and `#1805`) on `FieldBody` with axis-independent cut records and interval reads, removing `Dexel::history`.
   - **Done means:** `CarriedStock::Field` passes `stock_carry_side`, `stock_carry_side_exact`, and `carried_fixture_side_exact` with zero findings, and `FIELD_SIDE_CARRY_REFUSAL` is removed.
   - **Priority:** `P8` · **Effort:** `effort:max` · **Area:** `area:sim`

7. **Title:** `app(sim): flip default simulation and carried-stock engine to Backend::Field`
   - **What it does:** Switch `crates/app/src/stock_sim_held.rs` and `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs` to `Backend::Field`, verify cut-through depth checks pass, and remove `CAMCRAFT_CARRY_ENGINE`.
   - **Done means:** All app, sim, and motion suites pass with `Backend::Field` as the shipped default, and no production path builds `Backend::Column`.
   - **Priority:** `P6` · **Effort:** `effort:high` · **Area:** `area:sim`

8. **Title:** `sim: delete column cut engine, Backend::Column, comparison suites, and port baseline tests`
   - **What it does:** Decouple `Body`, `deviate`, `edge_break`, and `fixture_carried` from `Dexel`, delete `dexel*.rs`, `cut.rs`, `Backend::Column`, `Stock::Column`, and comparison suites, and port baseline tests.
   - **Done means:** One retirement commit removes the column cut engine, keeps golden verdicts unchanged, and accounts for all retired comparison tests and ported baseline tests.
   - **Priority:** `P6` · **Effort:** `effort:high` · **Area:** `area:sim`
